capabilities: Show related notes in a Connections view that updates while navigating
Search the vault by meaning instead of keywords
Embed notes with local Transformers.js or API providers
Cache embeddings locally and rebuild them when the model changes
Expose vault connections through an optional MCP server
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13.0+). Default local provider needs no key; note text is sent to API providers when chosen. Discloses network, storage, and server behavior in detail and states telemetry is none.
problem: Obsidian's search and backlinks rely on keywords and explicit links, so notes related by meaning but not wording or links stay hidden.
